name: Zechariah
title: The Prophet Who Foretold the Rebuilding of the Temple
summary: Zechariah was a prophet who served in the period after the exile in Babylon, encouraging the Jews to complete the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem. He is known for his apocalyptic visions and messianic prophecies that point forward to Christ. The book bearing his name contains some of the most detailed messianic prophecies in the Old Testament.

keyEvents.title: Call to Repentance
keyEvents.description: Zechariah began his prophetic ministry with a call for the people to turn back to the Lord, so that the Lord could turn back to them.

keyEvents.title: The Vision of the Eight Visions
keyEvents.description: Zechariah received a series of eight night visions concerning Jerusalem's future, the rebuilding of the temple, and God's plan for His people.

keyEvents.title: The Crowning of the High Priest Joshua
keyEvents.description: Zechariah was told to make a crown and place it on the head of the high priest Joshua, as a prophetic sign of the coming Branch – the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: The prophecy about the king who comes riding on a donkey
keyEvents.description: Zechariah prophesied that the King of Zion would come humbly, riding on a donkey – a prophecy fulfilled at Jesus' entry into Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The prophecy about the thirty silver pieces
keyEvents.description: Zechariah prophesied about the thirty silver pieces thrown to the potter, which was fulfilled when Judas betrayed Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The prophecy about the pierced one
keyEvents.description: Zechariah prophesied that the people would look on him whom they have pierced and mourn for him – a prophecy pointing to Jesus' crucifixion.
